_meta.description: Reference eGFR-based dose-safety thresholds for the Sprint 7 NSCRE Module B (organ function / dose safety evaluator). Illustrative dev subset -- real, well-established prescribing facts (not model-generated), keyed to Medication.key values confirmed to exist in the live PSKG graph from the synthetic seed data. Production would load licensed renal-dosing guidance (e.g. a formulary's renal impairment adjustment table), not this hand-curated subset.

rules.rationale: Metformin is contraindicated below eGFR 30 due to accumulation risk and lactic acidosis.
